title: Kissed Poblano Mexican Nectarines Sopes
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring crispy sopes topped with a flavorful poblano pepper stir-fry, juicy nectarines, and a sprinkle of queso fresco.
instructions: Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat.
Grill the corn tortillas for 30 seconds on each side, until crispy.
In a separate skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the poblanos to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced nectarines to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until slightly caramelized.
Top each crispy tortilla with a spoonful of the poblano pepper mixture, a sprinkle of queso fresco, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional sliced nectarines if desired.
